description: The source reports total assessment-roll area and acres actually irrigated by Alberta irrigation district. Two overlapping spreadsheet releases cover 2007–2014 and 2008–2015. These are engineered irrigation service-area observations; assessed area and actually irrigated area remain distinct measures. The metadata does not establish diversion volumes, irrigation efficiency, canal condition or crop water requirements. The files form one statistical series and were not downloaded or numerically compared. District definitions and any reporting changes are unstated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
